_comment: Verified traffic-signal metadata for the clearpath_demo SUMO network.
Verified against SUMO 1.27.1 using TraCI: the J1 program has four phases and
controlled links 0-2 are the north_in approaches. Phase 2 ('GGGrrrrrr') is the
only phase that shows green for north_in, so it is the pre-emption phase.
SumoTraCIAdapter re-verifies preemption_phase against the live phase program on
every start and refuses any phase that does not clear the corridor, so editing
this file cannot make a red or yellow phase pass.
traffic_signal_id is a placeholder UUID satisfying the schema; a deployment
stores this metadata on its TrafficSignal row.
